/**

 */export class RegisterDetection{static analyze(text){try{// Check each register type and return the strongest match

return{register:'neutral',adjustment:0,confidence:0,description:'No specific register markers detected',pattern:null};}catch(error){console.error('RegisterDetection error:',error);return{register:'error',adjustment:0,confidence:0,description:'Register analysis failed: '+error.message,pattern:null};}}static checkRegisterPatterns(text,patterns,registerType){for(const patternObj of patterns){if(patternObj.pattern.test(text)){return{match:true,adjustment:patternObj.weight*100,// Convert to percentage

static analyzeMultipleRegisters(text){const detectedRegisters=[];let totalAdjustment=0;let maxConfidence=0;let primaryRegister='neutral';// Check all register types
